preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(s) <= 100 for s in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each test case string s has a length between 1 and 100 inclusive.
Each test case string s consists only of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] in ['YES', 'NO', 'yes', 'no', 'Yes', 'No', 'yEs', 'yeS', 'YEs', 'yES'] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
postconditions.description: Each output is either YES or NO in any case.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.splitlines()[i] == ('YES' if stdin.splitlines()[i+1] == stdin.splitlines()[i+1][:len(stdin.splitlines()[i+1])//2] * 2 else 'NO') for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0])))
postconditions.description: The output is YES if the string is square, otherwise NO.
